title: Wind & Rain
own_art_list: All sound and music: synthesised at runtime with WebAudio in game/src/audio.js (no audio files)
Surface textures: procedural, generated at load time from code with the recipe's surfaces.js (no image files)
Effects and UI: wind ribbons, raincloud, dust and SVG icons, all written in code
what_i_found: There is no mining or chopping: income is ritual. Priestesses dance for Wind and priests kneel at sacred springs for Rain, and a raid does not steal resources but interrupts the rite. The economy is also the soundtrack, because every dancer adds a layer to the village's rhythm and every priest adds chant and thunder, so you hear your income grow and hear it falter when you are attacked.
